name: PenDC Bursa (Pen Veri Merkezi)
notes: Tier III+ certified carrier-independent colocation data center in Osmangazi district, Bursa (Ovaakca Egitim Mah., Istanbul Cad No:750/A). Operator site and datacenters.com list it as Tier III standard; Bursa press reports the ~1,600 sqm facility runs on solar power (GES first phase 259.65 kW) with UPS/generators and 3-city/4-city backup replication. No public MW capacity published.

name: DGN Teknoloji Bursa Data Center
notes: Bursa-based hosting/colocation provider operating its own data center building with dedicated server, colocation, cloud and private-cage services, 20+ years in sector, 7/24 support. Company marketing page; no MW capacity or certifications disclosed.

name: Bursa Veri Merkezi (Bursa Buyuksehir Belediyesi)
notes: Mayor Mustafa Bozbey announced at Kazan Digital Week (Sep 2025) that the municipality is taking steps to establish a 'Bursa Veri Merkezi' designed toward Tier IV standards, supporting smart-city services (city internet, IoT, digital twin, disaster communications). Local Bursa press report; no capacity or site published.

name: Bursa OSB Data Center Initiative
notes: Bursa OSB (Turkey's first organized industrial zone, 705 ha, 332 companies) President Huseyin Durmaz stated the OIZ targets hosting energy-intensive data centers under the Bursa OSB umbrella with safer and lower-energy operation, prioritizing needs and progressing step by step. Announced intent; no concrete site/MW.

name: INTETRA ITS Data Center (1915 Canakkale Bridge Project)
notes: INTETRA Group built a data center in Canakkale province consolidating server systems, telecommunications, data storage and toll collection (ITS/ETC) systems for the Canakkale-Malkara Highway and 1915 Canakkale Bridge project under one roof. Social-media (LinkedIn) evidence only; no MW or address published.

name: Denizli Buyuksehir Belediyesi Modular Data Center
developer: Denizli Buyuksehir Belediyesi (Bilgi Islem Dairesi Baskanligi)
notes: Official public tender announcement (EKAP no 2026/1431291, ilan.gov.tr ILN02528088) by Denizli Metropolitan Municipality Information Processing Dept for procurement of a modular data center system, delivery to Inciliplnar Mah. Pamukkale/Denizli within 90 days of contract; tender opening 03.09.2026. Procurement stage; capacity unknown.
